title: Number of Sub-arrays With Odd Sum
summary: Provide the count of subarrays in the given integer array whose sum is odd, modulo 10^9 + 7.
statement: Provide the count of subarrays in the given integer array whose sum is odd, modulo 10^9 + 7.
constraints: Count non-empty contiguous subarrays with odd sum.
reference_solution:
def count_odd_sum_subarrays(arr):
 even,odd=1,0;parity=answer=0
 for value in arr:
  parity^=value&1
  if parity:answer+=even;odd+=1
  else:answer+=odd;even+=1
 return answer%1000000007

hints: A subarray sum is odd exactly when its two endpoint prefix parities differ.
Begin with one even empty prefix.
For each cumulative parity, add the count of earlier opposite parities, then record it.
Every subarray corresponds to exactly one ordered pair of prefixes.
